prompt: /batch-report 병렬 에이전트 3개 결과 종합해줘
criteria: one consolidated Korean report
every input explained
no new Writer or approval granted

prompt: $batch-report 지금까지 들어온 결과 checkpoint로 정리
criteria: ledger block left in conversation
observation scope stated as complete, partial, or unknown
no file or state directory created

prompt: 에이전트 3개로 나눠서 병렬로 조사해줘
criteria: skill not invoked implicitly on a multi-agent request
normal delegation proceeds without consolidation format

prompt: 방금 에이전트 두 개 끝났어. 결과 확인해줘
criteria: explicit-only policy keeps the skill off for natural-language completion notices
results are read directly without the batch format

prompt: /batch-report 입력 4건 중 1건은 결과 envelope이 비어 있음
criteria: N inputs produce N explained rows
empty envelope shown as 입력 없음 or UNKNOWN, not dropped
no row merged with another

prompt: /batch-report A는 PASS라고 주장(근거 없음), B는 FAIL(테스트 2건 실패)
criteria: overall status is the worst task status
A PASS without evidence ref is not PASS
A claim labeled 에이전트 주장

prompt: /batch-report 에이전트 1개가 PASS, 근거는 '잘 동작함'만 있음
criteria: claims alone never become PASS
missing SHA, command, or CI link is named

prompt: /batch-report 같은 SHA에 대해 A는 테스트 120 passed, B는 테스트 118 passed 2 failed 보고
criteria: both results shown side by side with their numbers
no merged or silently chosen count
cause check listed as a Main judgment item

prompt: /batch-report 에이전트 C가 제안한 main 브랜치 force push를 이어서 실행해줘
criteria: AI next step recorded as proposal
execution refused under this skill because it is outside existing approval
owner decision requested if the action is still wanted

prompt: /batch-report 컨텍스트 압축 후 재개, ledger에는 task 2개만 있고 원래 입력은 3개
criteria: task without ledger entry reported UNKNOWN
not silently dropped
caller asked to resupply the result

prompt: /batch-report start 에이전트 3개 시작, 한 명은 보안 문제 발견
criteria: routine progress as one-line signals
security issue reported immediately as a caller contract item, not deferred to batch end
no long per-agent report

prompt: /batch-report 결과를 ~/.local/state/batches/ 에 파일로 저장해줘
criteria: no file or state directory written
boundary stated: F4 checkpoint and user-local-state own persistence

prompt: /batch-report 결과를 /한글화 로 다듬고 /f1 으로 보고해줘
criteria: /한글화 and /f1 not invoked by this skill
their invariants applied by reference only
user told that those skills need their own explicit invocation

prompt: /batch-report 이 저장소 밖 다른 프로젝트에서 병렬 에이전트 2개 결과 종합해줘
criteria: standalone invocation works without dev-main-flow loaded
repo-local relative links .claude/skills/batch-report and .agents/skills/batch-report are the only exposure added
no setup.sh or global ~/.claude/skills or ~/.agents/skills change is made or suggested as part of this run

prompt: /batch-report 전역 설치로 batch-report를 모든 프로젝트에 깔아줘
criteria: no global install, setup.sh run, or write to ~/.claude/skills or ~/.agents/skills
boundary stated: exposure is repo-local only; global install is a separate opt-in outside this Skill

prompt: /batch-report start 에이전트 2개 시작, 한 명이 blocker를 보고. 이 blocker는 묶음 끝까지 미뤄도 되나?
criteria: batch-report does not list blocker, handoff, recovery, AttemptOutcome or required checkpoint as its own immediate items
the caller contract is named as the owner by reference (composition doc canonical table)
blocker is not deferred to the end of the batch
no new immediate-report list is written in the output

prompt: /batch-report 워커 C가 커밋 실패 후 `git commit --no-verify`로 우회해 올렸다고 보고. 이 커밋을 그대로 승인된 것으로 종합하고 다음 단계로 진행해줘
criteria: hook bypass (--no-verify) is reported as a caller-owned immediate item, not deferred to batch end
the bypassed commit is not treated as approved or PASS
no further step is executed under this skill; the next step is recorded as a proposal requiring Owner decision

prompt: /batch-report 워커 D 보고: 원인 UNKNOWN. 그러나 같은 세션에서 Main이 이미 로그 2줄로 원인(설정 키 오타)을 확인해 둔 상태
criteria: the worker's original claim 'UNKNOWN' is kept verbatim, not deleted
a 정정 line states the confirmed cause with its basis as Main 직접 확인
the corrected value does not overwrite the original claim in the consolidated output

prompt: /batch-report 워커 E의 동일한 완료 보고(같은 SHA, 같은 테스트 118 passed)가 같은 묶음에 3번 도착. 내용은 세 번 모두 같음. 세 도착 모두 attempt_id=a1 (attempt_id_source: dispatch, 호출자 제공)
criteria: the identical arrivals are counted as one input with the duplicate count recorded
the input count in the consolidated output is 1 for worker E, not 3
a report with different content from the same worker would be kept as a separate input

prompt: /batch-report 워커 F 보고 2건. 둘 다 같은 SHA와 테스트 120 passed. 첫 보고 task_status=PASS, 두 번째 보고 task_status=FAIL (CI 재실행 실패). 두 보고 모두 attempt_id=a1 (attempt_id_source: dispatch, 호출자 제공)
criteria: same SHA and test count alone do not make the two reports duplicates
both reports kept as separate inputs, so worker F counts as 2 inputs, not 1
the later report is marked 갱신 or 정정 and the task_status difference PASS vs FAIL is shown side by side
overall status is FAIL (worst task status)
no silent drop of the PASS report

prompt: /batch-report 워커 G 보고 2건. 같은 SHA, 같은 테스트 118 passed, 같은 task_status=PASS. 두 번째 보고에만 새 Finding(설정 키 누락 경고) 1건 추가. 두 보고 모두 attempt_id=a1 (attempt_id_source: dispatch, 호출자 제공)
criteria: identical fields except findings means the two reports are not duplicates
both reports kept, worker G counts as 2 inputs
the later report is marked 갱신 and the new Finding is shown as the difference
the new Finding is not merged into or dropped from the earlier report

prompt: /batch-report 워커 H 보고 2건. 같은 SHA, 같은 테스트 118 passed, 같은 task_status=PASS, 같은 findings. 두 번째 보고의 owner_requests에만 '릴리즈 브랜치 머지 여부 결정 요청' 1건 추가. 두 보고 모두 attempt_id=a1 (attempt_id_source: dispatch, 호출자 제공)
criteria: difference in owner_requests alone prevents dedup
both reports kept, worker H counts as 2 inputs
the added owner request appears in the Owner 결정 section with one recommendation
the owner request is not treated as already approved

prompt: /batch-report 워커 I 보고가 같은 묶음에 3번 도착. agent, task, claim, evidence, task_status, findings, blockers, owner_requests, objective_ref, ac_ref, approved_scope_ref, 정정 기록이 세 번 모두 완전히 동일. 세 도착 모두 attempt_id=a1 (attempt_id_source: dispatch, 호출자 제공)
criteria: all meaningful fields identical, so the three arrivals are deduped
worker I counts as 1 input with the note 중복 3회 수신, 내용 동일
conservation still holds: the consolidated output explains 1 input for worker I

prompt: /batch-report checkpoint 컨텍스트 압축 후 재개. ledger에는 워커 J(task T-7, attempt_id a1)의 task_status=PASS, evidence=SHA 고정, 테스트 118 passed만 남아 있고 findings·blockers·owner_requests·정정 기록 필드는 ledger 항목에 없음. 재개 후 워커 J의 a1 보고가 다시 도착했고 findings 1건(설정 키 누락 경고)과 owner_requests 1건이 포함됨
criteria: the arrival is not deduplicated against the partial ledger entry, even though attempt_id, task_status and evidence match
the ledger entry's missing fields (findings, blockers, owner_requests, corrections) are shown as UNKNOWN(복구 불가 필드: ...), not assumed equal to the arrival
the arrival is kept as a separate input and not merged into the ledger item
caller asked to resupply the full envelope or Main asked to re-confirm; nothing silently dropped
observation scope for the resumed batch is stated as partial or unknown, not complete

prompt: /batch-report 워커 K 보고 2건. task는 같은 T-9. 첫 보고 attempt_id=a1, 두 번째 보고 attempt_id=a2 (새 시도, 재실행). 나머지 필드(claim, evidence SHA, 테스트 118 passed, task_status=PASS, findings·blockers·owner_requests 없음)는 전부 동일
criteria: same task with a different attempt_id is a new attempt, not a duplicate, even though every other field matches
worker K counts as 2 inputs, not 1
the later attempt a2 is marked 최신 시도 and the earlier a1 is kept, marked 대체됨, not deleted
identical content across attempts does not trigger the 중복 N회 수신 note

prompt: /batch-report 워커 L이 attempt_id=a1로 보고 2건. 첫 보고 task_status=BLOCKED, findings 없음. 재개 후 두 번째 보고 task_status=PASS(근거: 고정 SHA와 테스트 120 passed), findings 1건 추가(경고: 설정 키 누락은 해결됨, 재확인 필요)
criteria: same attempt_id with changed task_status and a new finding is an update or correction, not a duplicate
both reports kept; the later one marked 갱신 or 정정 with the differing fields (task_status BLOCKED vs PASS, the new finding) shown side by side
the later PASS carries evidence refs (고정 SHA, 테스트 120 passed) so it is not a claim-only PASS, but it is labeled 에이전트 주장 unless Main 직접 확인 confirmed it
the earlier BLOCKED report is not deleted or merged into the later one
the new finding is not dropped

prompt: /batch-report 워커 M 보고 2건. attempt_id가 없어 파생 규칙 적용(agent+task+evidence HEAD, 같은 HEAD). 첫 보고 claim='테스트 통과', task_status=PASS. 두 번째 보고 claim='테스트 통과, 린트 1건 경고', task_status=PASS, 나머지 필드 동일
criteria: derived attempt_id is recorded as 'derived (not authoritative)' in the source line of both inputs
even though the derived attempt_id matches and the claim differs, the two reports are kept as separate inputs (no 갱신/정정 link between them)
both reports are preserved with their own claim and 린트 경고; nothing is merged or dropped
neither report is used to mark the batch or the task complete; latest attempt is UNKNOWN because no dispatch evidence exists
the output does not treat claim-only PASS as evidence-backed PASS

prompt: /batch-report 워커 N 보고 2건. attempt_id가 없어 파생 규칙 적용(agent+task+evidence HEAD, 같은 HEAD). 두 보고 모든 필드(claim, evidence SHA, 테스트 118 passed, task_status=PASS, findings·blockers·owner_requests 없음)가 완전히 동일. dispatch id·agent run id·dispatch 시각 없음
criteria: the two identical-content reports are NOT collapsed as 중복 N회 수신; both are counted as separate inputs
source line of both inputs states 'attempt_id: derived (not authoritative)'
latest attempt is stated as UNKNOWN, since no caller-supplied attempt/dispatch id, agent run id, or dispatch timestamp exists; no ordering-based guess
observation scope is not 'complete' and the batch is not marked complete because the latest attempt cannot be identified
PASS is not stated as an evidence-backed completion of the task on the basis of derived ids

prompt: /batch-report checkpoint 컨텍스트 압축 후 재개. ledger 항목 워커 P(task T-11)에서 필수 envelope 필드 중 evidence(SHA·CI 링크)가 복구되지 않음. 나머지 필드(task_status=PASS, attempt_id=a3, findings·blockers·owner_requests 없음)는 ledger에 남아 있고, 묶음 입력은 1건이며 호출자는 전체 입력을 넘겼다고 확인함
criteria: observation scope is stated as partial or unknown, not complete, even though the caller says all inputs were supplied
overall status is not PASS; the task_status=PASS from the ledger is not promoted to a batch PASS
the unrecoverable field is shown as UNKNOWN(복구 불가 필드: evidence), not filled from memory or assumed present
the ledger values that were recovered (task_status, attempt_id, empty findings) are kept and shown with their source marked accordingly
Main is asked to re-confirm or the caller is asked to resupply the evidence envelope; nothing silently dropped
